description: This file contains internal implementation details for the Abseil Strings library, specifically for string joining functionalities such as formatters, join algorithms, and tuple handling. It defines classes, templates, and functions used internally to support string concatenation and formatting operations.

classes.name: AlphaNumFormatterImpl
classes.description: Default formatter converting alpha-numeric types to strings.

classes.name: NoFormatter
classes.description: Formatter type indicating no additional formatting needed.

classes.name: StreamFormatterImpl
classes.description: Formatter that uses a string stream to format objects.

classes.name: PairFormatterImpl
classes.description: Formatter for std::pair objects, formatting first and second members with a separator.

classes.name: DereferenceFormatterImpl
classes.description: Formatter that dereferences pointers before formatting.

classes.name: JoinTupleLoop
classes.description: Template struct for iterating over tuple elements for joining.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Various overloads for formatting objects, including for AlphaNum, stream, pairs, and dereferenced pointers.

methods.name: JoinAlgorithm
methods.description: Main function to join elements in a range with a separator, using a formatter.

methods.name: JoinRange
methods.description: Functions to join elements of a range or container into a string.
